scripts.build:extension: vite build -c vite.extension.config.ts && EXTENSION_PART=content vite build -c vite.extension.config.ts
scripts.zip:extension: npm run build:extension && cd extension/dist && rm -f ../edge-guard-extension.zip && python3 -m zipfile -c ../edge-guard-extension.zip * && echo 'extension/edge-guard-extension.zip has the App Check debug token: share it with judges privately, never publish it.'
scripts.zip:extension:public: VITE_EXTENSION_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN= npm run build:extension && vite-node scripts/check-no-secrets.ts extension/dist && cd extension/dist && rm -f ../edge-guard-extension-public.zip && python3 -m zipfile -c ../edge-guard-extension-public.zip * && echo extension/edge-guard-extension-public.zip
scripts.release:extension: npm run zip:extension:public && cp extension/edge-guard-extension-public.zip public/extension/edge-guard-extension.zip && npm run build && vite-node scripts/check-no-secrets.ts public/extension dist && echo 'Ready: npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting'
